title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
content: The AntPool block came within 984 transactions of Bitcoin’s 2015 record, even as fees made up less than 0.1% of the miner’s payout.

title: Google’s AI chip push adds more pressure on Nvidia
content: Google’s specialised AI chips threaten greater competition as Nvidia faces a leadership investigation.

title: North Korean hackers are creating memecoins to wash loot from $6.3 billion Binance hack
content: North Korean hackers used six homemade memecoins to launder 117,000 NEAR, worth about $430,000, from the $6.3 billion Binance hack, Elliptic says.

title: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks amid Wall Street's blockchain race
content: Avalanche will serve as the core settlement ledger for the exchange's planned blockchain stock market

title: Solana set for its first tokenized stock venue under SEC framework, listing Galaxy
content: Formation Securities plans to launch in early 2027 with Galaxy, Exodus and Forward Industries shares, expanding the U.S. regulator's experiment in blockchain-based stock trading.

title: Mercado Bitcoin begins post-hack reopening without a timeline for withdrawals
content: Customers can view their pre-hack balances as access returns in phases. The exchange has yet to say when withdrawals will resume.

title: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
content: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.

title: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
content: Avalanche’s AVAX token rose as much as 10% after the NYSE selected its blockchain to support settlement on a planned tokenized stock trading platform.

title: Bitcoin, tech stocks brush off Nvidia nerves as analyst mulls $68K target
content: Bitcoin rebounded from an 11-week low near $73,500 as the Nasdaq Composite rallied despite sell-off in Nvidia shares.

title: Analysts see no broader ‘contagion’ from $6.3B Binance hack
content: Binance’s pledge to cover all user losses helped contain the fallout from the $6.3 billion hack, analysts said.

title: Nvidia's $350 Billion Scare: What Happens If Jensen Huang Leaves?
content: Nvidia shares slid as much as 8% amid spy allegations. The stock was already weakening, and investors now face a bigger question: Who replaces Jensen Huang if he suddenly leaves?

title: Solana Set for Another Tokenized Stock Venue as Formation Notifies the SEC
content: Operating under the SEC’s “Innovation Exemption,” the firm plans to list tokenized shares of Exodus, Forward Industries, and Galaxy Digital in early 2027, with the same voting and dividend rights as real stock.

title: Vitalik Buterin Moves On From ‘Ultrasound Money,’ Says ETH’s Value Is Stability
content: The Ethereum co-founder says ETH's value comes from stability, not fee burns, citing its decentralization, censorship resistance and security.

title: Tom Lee’s Bitmine Adds $20M in Ethereum, Seizing on Vitalik’s 'ETH Is Money' Declaration
content: The firm’s stash reached 6.07 million ETH—4.97% of supply and 99% of the way to its “Alchemy of 5%” goal—as chairman Tom Lee called Vitalik Buterin’s “ETH is money” comments a “seismic shift.”

title: NYSE Taps Avalanche to Settle Its Planned Tokenized Stock Platform
content: Ava Labs said Avalanche will serve as the “core ledger technology” for the clearing firm behind the NYSE-affiliated venue, which aims to bring 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement of tokenized securities onchain.

title: North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot
content: Bitcoin Magazine North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot Elliptic says North Korean launderers created six throwaway meme tokens on NEAR between Nov. 5 and 7, moving about $430,000 of stolen Binance funds through homemade liquidity pools. This post North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: TD Cowen Gives Stablecoin Yield Ban 10% Odds as Banks Plan Push in Democrat-Led Congress
content: Bitcoin Magazine TD Cowen Gives Stablecoin Yield Ban 10% Odds as Banks Plan Push in Democrat-Led Congress TD Cowen's Jaret Seiberg puts only a 10% chance on a congressional ban on platform stablecoin yield over the next two years, even as banks renew their push after Democratic midterm wins. This post TD Cowen Gives Stablecoin Yield Ban 10% Odds as Banks Plan Push in Democrat-Led Congress first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: BlackRock: Security Fears Are Driving Bitcoin Whales Into IBIT
content: Bitcoin Magazine BlackRock: Security Fears Are Driving Bitcoin Whales Into IBIT BlackRock's Robbie Mitchnick told Barron's demand to swap directly held bitcoin for IBIT shares is at its highest yet, with "security and peace of mind" the top reason as kidnappings and hacks rise. This post BlackRock: Security Fears Are Driving Bitcoin Whales Into IBIT first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Binance to Close Accounts in Four EU Countries Dec. 31, Charging Idle Balances From Nov. 29
content: Bitcoin Magazine Binance to Close Accounts in Four EU Countries Dec. 31, Charging Idle Balances From Nov. 29 Binance told users in France, Spain, Italy and Poland to withdraw their crypto, with deposits blocked, accounts closing Dec. 31 and a monthly fee starting Nov. 29, as the exchange still lacks an EU license. This post Binance to Close Accounts in Four EU Countries Dec. 31, Charging Idle Balances From Nov. 29 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: U.S. Regulators Drop $250 Travel Rule Plan, Crypto Language Too
content: Bitcoin Magazine U.S. Regulators Drop $250 Travel Rule Plan, Crypto Language Too FinCEN and the Federal Reserve formally withdrew a 2020 proposal that would have cut the cross-border funds-transfer threshold from $3,000 to $250 and spelled out that the rules cover crypto, saying any future version needs a fresh comment period. This post U.S. Regulators Drop $250 Travel Rule Plan, Crypto Language Too first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
